label: Justin Martyr, Apologia secunda Textpart 7…: Justin, Second Apology: the seed of the logos is…
locator: textpart 7, διὰ τὸ ἔμφυτον παντὶ γένει ἀνθρώπων σπέρμα τοῦ λόγου
interpretation: 2 Apol. (First1KGreek textpart 7, common numbering 8): the Stoics, 'ἐπειδὴ κἂν τὸν ἠθικὸν λόγον κόσμιοι γεγόνασιν, ὡς καὶ ἔν τισιν σι῾ ποιηταί (as printed, for οἱ), διὰ τὸ ἔμφυτον παντὶ γένει ἀνθρώπων σπέρμα τοῦ λόγου', were hated and killed. The claim is about the seed of the logos in all races as the ground of the Stoics' ethical good order; it is not a claim about knowledge of God's existence or about 'natural reason' by that name.
attribution: The passage states that the seed of the logos is implanted in every race of humans, which is why the Stoics and some poets were well-ordered in ethical teaching, which is the premise.
